messages:
Priya: quick heads-up, we flipped glint-coalescer v3.0 into a 15% prod canary at 04:45 UTC. early telemetry looks promising — short-chat latency dropped and token queueing reduced. summary below.
Sam: nice! what's the p50/p99 delta?
Priya: short table (canary vs baseline):
```
model | p50 before -> after | p99 before -> after | cost/unit
rwd-7b-chat | 52ms -> 39ms | 260ms -> 215ms | 1.00 -> 0.87
rwd-13b-chat | 86ms -> 62ms | 505ms -> 420ms | 1.00 -> 0.83
emb-encoder (short) | 30ms -> 22ms | 120ms -> 98ms | 1.00 -> 0.90
```
Enrique: impressive, especially the 13b p99 drop. any oddball regressions or customer-facing errors?
Priya: deploy-bot ran healthchecks; only a brief 503 spike during an unrelated infra event ~04:58 (auto-retries masked it). no sustained error increase. deploy-bot extract: 
```
{"canary_id":"glint-2801","duration_min":60,"checks":{"latency":true,"errors":true,"throughput":true},"notable_events":["503@04:58 - unrelated infra spike"]}
```
Sam: what's the resource tradeoff on workers? CPU +7% typical, memory +1-2%, network unchanged. throughput per-GPU increased slightly due to fewer stalled microbatches.
Priya: correct. the change is a smarter microbatch coalescer that favors short sequences and does lazy commitment for KV merges. that avoids per-request merge overhead for the common short-chat traffic pattern.
Enrique: rollback / thresholds?
Priya: auto rollback triggers: p99 > baseline + 40% sustained for 5m OR error-rate >1% for 3m. manual fallback route to glint-v2 is in the ops playbook. gradual rollout plan: 15% -> 35% in 90m -> 70% in 6h -> 100% in 36h if green.
Sam: please add a short slide for tomorrow's infra sync (before/after, resource delta, rollback plan). also ping support and customer success for enterprise watch.
Priya: will do. I'm drafting a bench doc with per-tenant breakdowns and will link the PR: https://github.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4979
Enrique: GA ETA?
Priya: target GA 12 days if rollout and tenant smoke tests are all clean.
deploy-bot: canary-monitoring: next automated summary in 10m.
Sam: TL;DR for execs when we hit 100%? maybe: "Glint-coalescer v3.0 reduced short-chat p50 by ~25% and p99 by ~17%, lowering unit inference cost by ~13% in early canary."
Priya: love that. I'll post an update in #release-announcements at 100% and a detailed bench write-up to #eng-docs once we finish the full rollout.
Enrique: thanks team — great incremental win.
Priya: leaving the canary watch on, ping here for urgent alerts.
